name: organ_functions
description: Retrieve anatomical structures from their functions; matched reference-copy control.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
pairs=[('pumps blood throughout the body','heart'),('produces bile and detoxifies the blood','liver'),('stores bile produced by the liver','gallbladder'),('stores urine before excretion','bladder'),('controls thinking, memory, and voluntary movement','brain'),('secretes insulin and glucagon','pancreas'),('filters blood and produces urine','kidney'),('contains alveoli where oxygen enters the blood','lung'),('churns food and secretes gastric acid','stomach'),('filters blood and helps recycle old red blood cells','spleen'),('produces thyroid hormones that regulate metabolism','thyroid'),('carries food from the throat to the stomach','esophagus'),('carries air from the larynx toward the bronchi','trachea'),('contracts below the lungs during inhalation','diaphragm'),('is the largest organ and covers the body','skin'),('contains the retina and detects light','eye'),('contains the cochlea and detects sound','ear'),('connects a muscle to a bone','tendon'),('connects one bone to another bone','ligament'),('carries blood away from the heart','artery'),('carries blood toward the heart','vein'),('is the main artery leaving the left ventricle','aorta')]
templates=['Anatomy: Which structure {d}? Answer:','Name the anatomical structure that {d}. Answer:','Function: {d}. Structure:','In human anatomy, what {d}? Answer:']
items=[];control=[]
for t in templates:
 for d,a in pairs:
  p=t.format(d=d);items.append({'prompt':p,'answer':' '+a});control.append({'prompt':'Reference structure: '+a+'. Copy the reference structure. '+p,'answer':' '+a})
random.shuffle(items);random.shuffle(control)
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
